output.one_liner: SendGrid is a cloud-based email delivery platform that sends email at scale with proven deliverability.

auth.notes: Requires API key created in SendGrid console; bearer_token sends API key as 'Bearer <key>' header; basic sends as 'apikey:<key>' HTTP basic auth. No OAuth support.

evidence.snippet: Twilio SendGrid supports API keys delivered via Bearer token or Basic authentication
To use an API key, pass an Authorization header with a value of Bearer <Your-API-Key-Here>
When using Basic Authentication, your username will always be apikey, and your password will be your API key

access.notes: Free trial with no credit card required; Sandbox Mode mentioned in docs but operational details not provided in given pages.

evidence.snippet: Sign up for a free trial—no credit card required
Transparent pricing with discounts as you scale. Sign up for a free trial—no credit card required

Get started with the Event webhook
To have Twilio SendGrid post email event data to a URL you control, add and configure an Event Webhook

buildability.rationale: Composio toolkit with 364 tools already published and operational; self-serve trial credentials available without sales contact.
